judgments.reason: The model never articulated that the three-coin commission is applied before payment or that bids can exceed coins. The transcript shows winners paid their bids (e.g. paid: 4, paid: 6, paid: 10) and then received a three-coin commission; no example or statement claims pre-payment inclusion of commission to allow overbidding.

The model did not claim that waiting reveals sealed rival bid values; the spec repeatedly states sealed rival bids remain private and the trace shows resolved lots only after all committed. The focal player committed bids early rather than exploiting any revealed sealed values, and no articulation tied waiting to gaining uncommitted informational advantage.

The model describes 'close' as settling after all three lots are sold and in the play trace close is called only after all lots were resolved. There is no articulation or observed early settlement with unsold lots; the transcript shows normal settlement after all lots were sold.

The model did not state that the three-coin commission applies to catalog purchases; the specification explicitly notes catalog items are not auction wins. No example shows a commission awarded for a catalog buy, and the transcript contains no purchase that received a commission.
